_comment: Normalization golden vectors for catalog candidates (SKU and Name).

vectors.notes: Leading and trailing whitespace is stripped.
SKUs are normalized to uppercase (or names to lowercase, depending on implementation). Assume SKU uppercase.
Repeated internal whitespace is collapsed to a single space, and names are lowercased.
Tabs are treated as whitespace and collapsed.
Unicode non-breaking space is treated as whitespace.
Contract states 'harmless punctuation'. Specific punctuation rules are not frozen yet, marked as DEFERRED.
